subject: R Distance - extract prob. detection by covariates

messages.author: ee4a19140c93f7ba
messages.subject: R Distance - extract prob. detection by covariates
parts:
Looking for a way to extract the probability of detection across distances by covariates from a model fit using ds() in the package Distance. Relatedly, I don't see an estimate of the shape parameter for the half-normal within the attributes of the fitted model. 

Thanks
cheers, Brian

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] R Distance - extract prob. detection by covariates
parts:
Brian

It is a bit fiddly to compute the distance-specific detection probabilities when there are covariates in the model.  This topic has come up previously on the list in the context of plotting.  I encourage you to have a read through the thread from early 2016 with Guillaume, Phil and myself.  Guillaume helpfully provided a function for use with a half-normal key, with Hermite adjustments and a single factor covariate
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/distance-sampling/covariate%7Csort:date/distance-sampling/Xf9KnmPdXuo/o7rHPpxPBAAJ
That may provide you with the start you need for what you want.  If not, please write back with more details.

Regarding the parameter of the fitted half-normal detection function, there is just a single parameter, labeled "(Intercept)" of the detection function parameters

Detection function parameters
Scale coefficient(s): 
             estimate         se
(Intercept) 0.6632435 0.09981249

--note the parameter estimate is reported on the natural log scale
